name: windows_mouse
description: Move the pointer or click a captured window point. park: move it off the window so no tooltip or hover state lands in a screenshot. move/hover: to a point or ref. scroll: wheel ticks over a point or ref (positive scrolls up). click: left-click at a point or ref. drag: press at `from` (or ref, or ref's fromEdge), move in steps, release at `to`, toRef/toEdge, or wherever resizeTo makes ref that size (a column header: ref + fromEdge right + resizeTo 250). Use it for splitters and other targets UI Automation does not expose. Points are pixels in a windows_screenshot of the same window (handle), so read them straight off a capture.

action.description: park, move, hover, scroll, drag or click; see the tool description for what each needs.

handle.description: Window handle; points are relative to its capture.

ref.description: Element to move to, hover, scroll over, or drag from.

from.description: Drag start in window pixels (alternative to ref).

to.description: Target in window pixels: move/hover/scroll/click point, or drag end.

ticks.description: scroll: wheel ticks, positive is up.

fromEdge.description: drag: grab this edge of ref instead of its centre (e.g. right for a column header's divider).

fromMustHit.description: drag with a raw from point: refuse before input unless the point is on this element ref.

toMustHit.description: drag with a raw to point: require this element ref before input and recheck it before release.

toRef.description: drag: release on this element instead of a `to` point.

fromMustNotHit.description: drag: refs the start point must not land on (a neighbouring pane's caption, say); the drag is refused before the button goes down when UI Automation reports one of them, or something inside it, there.

toEdge.description: drag: which part of toRef to release on (default center; left drops a column header before it).

resizeTo.description: drag with ref + fromEdge: release where ref becomes this many pixels wide (left/right) or tall (top/bottom). One call, no screenshot needed.
